senses.gloss:
r. 5th cl. (अहति)
To pervade or occupy.
(इ.) अहि r. 1st cl. (अंहते)
To go or move;
also 10th cl. (अंहयति)
To shine.

ind.
A particle and interjection implying,
1 Commendation.
2 Rejecting, sending.
3 Deviation from custom, (improperly).
4 Certainty, ascertainment.
E.
अ neg. ह from हन to hurt, affix ड.

ind.
An interjection, aha! ah! implying,
1 Casting, sending.
2 Severity, reproof.
3 Commanding.

mfn. (-युः-युः-यु)
Proud.
m. (-युः)
A warrior.
E.
अहम् I, and युस् affix: self-opinioned.

m. (-तिः)
The sun.
E.
अहन् a day, and पति a master.

n. (-षं)
Evening.
E.
अहन् and शेष end.

m. (-रः)
1 Pride.
2 Individuality, sense of self.
3 One of the elements of creation, consciousness, individualization.
E.
अहम् I, and कार what makes; thinking highly of one's self.

mfn. (-बान्-वती-वत्)
Proud.
E.
अहंङ्कार pride, मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Proud, self-important.
E.
अहंङ्कार and इनि poss. aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Proud.
E.
अहम् I, and कृत made: see अहंकार.

f. (-तिः)
Pride.
E.
अहम् and कृति action: see अहङ्कार.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unhurt, uninjured, not struck or killed.
2 Unblemished, unsoiled.
n. (-तं)
New clothes.
E.
अ neg. and हत hurt, part. past. of हन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Struck, beaten.
2 Injured, killed.
3 Multiplied.
4 Known, understood.
5 Uttered falsely.
n. (-तं)
1 Old. [] cloth or raiment.
2 New cloth or clothes.
3 Assertion of an impossibility.
m. (-तः)
A drum.
E.
आङ्, हन to hurt or injure, affix क्त.

m. (-हः)
A day.
E.
अ neg. हा to leave, and कनिन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not to be killed.
E.
अ neg. हननीथ to be killed.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Not to be killed.
E.
अ neg. हन्तव्य to be killed.

f. (-का)
1 Military vaunting.
2 Assertion or conceit of superiority, boasting, egotism.
E.
अहम् I, reiterated, क and टाप् affixed.

f. (-का)
1 Emulative onset, the running forward of soldiers with emulation.
2 Conceit, vaunting.
E.
अहं I, पूर्ब्व first; affixes as in the last; I will be foremost, &c.

f. (-तिः)
1 Spiritual ignorance.
2 Conceit.
3 Self-love.
E.
अहम् and मति understanding; self-love, or worldly mindedness, opposed to abstract meditation on the deity.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not to be taken away.
E.
अ neg. हरणीय to be taken.

ind.
Daily, day by day.
E.
अहम् repeated.

m. (-णः)
1 A month.
2 Any calculated term.
E.
अहन् a day, and गण a number or class.

ind.
Day and night.
E.
अहन् day, निशा night.

m. (-तिः)
The sun.
E.
अहन् and पति a master; also अहः, पति.

m. (-वः)
The sun.
E.
अहन् and बान्धब a friend.

m. (-णिः)
The sun.
E.
अहन् and मणि a gem.

n. (-खं)
Morning, the dawn.
E.
अहन् and मुख the commencement.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Unploughed, unfurrowed.
E.
अ neg. हस्ति a furrow, अच् affix: also with the final unchanged, अहलि.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Unploughed, (a field, &c.)
f. (-ल्या)
1 The name of an Apsaras or heavenly courtezan.
2 The wife of GAUTAMA, a saint and philosopher.
E.
अ neg. हल to plough, यत् aff.

mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं)
Unhappy, gloomy, sorrowful.
E.
अ neg. हर्ष happiness.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unhappy, sorrowful.
E.
अ neg. हर्षित rejoiced.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Not to be offered, not fit or proper to be sacrificed.
E.
अ neg. हबनीय to be offered.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be offered as an oblation.
m. (-यः)
A consecrated fire taken from the householder's perpetual fire, and prepared for receiving oblations.
E.
आङ्, हु to offer oblations, and अनीयर् aff.

m. (-रः)
The sun.
E.
अहन् and कर who makes.

m. (-तिः)
1 The sun.
2 Swallow wort.
E.
अहन् and पति master.

ind.
A particle or interjection, as ah! aha! &c. implying:
1 Surprise:
2 Fatigue:
3 Pain:
4 Pleasure:
5 Calling.
E.
अह from अहम् I, and ह from हा to abandon: self or pride-abandonment; also अहहा.

ind.
See the preceding.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Not to be stolen or taken away.
m. (-र्य्यः)
A mountain.
E.
अ neg. and हार्य्य future part. of हृञ् to take or convey.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
1 Adventitious, accessory^1, incidental.
2 To be taken or seized.
3 To be eaten.
m. (-र्य्यः)
The ornamentative part of the drama, the dress, decorations, &c.
E.
आङ् before हृञ् to convey, ण्यत् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-त्वं)
Security, not being liable to be stolen or taken away.
E.
अहार्य्य and त्व affix; also अहार्य्यता.

m. (-कः)
A disease of the nose, inflammation of the Schneiderian membrane.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Noted for good qualities.
E.
आहत known, and लक्षण a mark.

m. (-रः)
1 Breath inspired, inspiration.
2 Taking, seizing.
E.
आङ् before हृ to take, अप् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Food.
2 Taking, conveying.
E.
आङ्, हृ to convey, घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Taking, seizing.
2 Causing, inducing.
3 Extracting, removing.
E.
आङ् before हृ to take, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ)
One who takes or seizes.
m. (-र्त्ता)
(In law,) A copy-holder.
E.
आङ् before हृ to take, तृच् aff.

m. (-वः)
1 War, battle.
2 Sacrificing.
E.
आङ् before हु to sacrifice or ह्वेञ्^1 to call, and अच् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

m. (-वः)
1 A trough near a well for watering cattle.
2 War, battle.
3 Calling.
E.
आङ् before ह्वे to call, घञ् affix, deriv. irr.

n. (-नं)
Sacrifice, offering sacrifice.
E.
आङ् before हु to sacrifice, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Fit for a burnt offering.
m. (कः)
A consecrated fire.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-बः)
The juice of the body, chyle, lymph, serum, &c.
E.
आहार food, and सम्भव what is produced.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
Begging or seeking for food.
E.
आहार and अर्थिन् who asks.

f. (-भा)
Adventitious beauty, beauty not natural but the effect of pain, ornaments, &c.
E.
आहार्य्य incidental, and शाभा splendor.
